props.title: NOTUA – the most powerful creative planning & mind-map app.
props.text: Plan projects, sort ideas and connect them on one endless board: notes, tables, tasks, widgets and boards inside boards. Made by me – free to use.
props.endText: Runs in the browser, as a desktop app and on Android.
props.featureText:
Notes | Capture ideas the second they appear – scripts, shot notes, thoughts. Everything lives on one endless canvas.
Tables | Scene overview, budget, schedule – clear in cells.
Tasks | Tick off what is done, keep the rest in sight.
Widgets | Pin images, YouTube videos and Spotify playlists right next to your ideas.
Boards | Boards inside boards – every project gets its own space.
Your look | Make it yours: colour world, light or dark, corners, shadow, border and font. Then keep the look.
